raised.claim: The tool schema now carries a `minLength` string constraint, which Anthropic strict tool use / structured outputs documents as an unsupported JSON Schema keyword (alongside maxLength, minimum, maximum), so the request may be rejected with a 400 rather than enforced.
raised.why_it_breaks: If the provider rejects `minLength` in a strict tool schema, every triage call that sends ANALYSIS_TOOL_SCHEMA fails at request time with a schema-validation 400, so the whole daily triage run fails on every day (not just on the one bad term the PR is fixing). The PR relies on a single live probe for this; zod already enforces `.min(1)` on `contains`, so dropping `minLength` from the branch would lose nothing on the validation side.
